newsitem.title: USA: IntelliQuest files for 2.88 mln shr offer.
newsitem.headline: IntelliQuest files for 2.88 mln shr offer.

text.p: IntelliQuest Information Group Inc said Tuesday it has filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a 2,881,000 share follow-on public offering.
IntelliQuest will sell 1,000,000 of the shares, and selling stockholders will sell the remaining 1,881,000, the company said.
Certain stockholders will also grant underwriters the option to buy up to 432,150 more shares to cover over-allotments.
IntelliQuest said it won't receive any of the proceeds from shares sold by stockholders.
Austin-based IntelliQuest provides quantitative marketing information to technology companies.
